summary: The agent implements a standard LightGBM regression pipeline with randomized Group K-fold cross-validation. However, it completely fails at feature engineering by discarding crucial atom indices needed to derive interatomic distances, throwing away most of the task's signal. Furthermore, it introduces a critical execution bug by hardcoding submission IDs instead of preserving the test set's original IDs.
